slo_title: Retrieve and process query results using ResultSet

mcq.q: What does the ResultSet object represent in JDBC?

options.A: An object to connect with database
options.C: A table of data representing the result of a SQL query

mcq.answer_text: A table of data representing the result of a SQL query

mcq.q: Which of the following statements is true about the executeUpdate() method in JDBC?

options.B: It is used only for SELECT queries
options.C: It returns the number of rows affected
options.D: It creates a new table in the database

mcq.answer_text: It returns the number of rows affected

mcq.q: Given a ResultSet rs , which of the following correctly retrieves the value of a column named "email" as a String ?
What will happen if you call rs.getInt("age") before calling rs.next() ?

options.D: It moves to the next row automatically

sq.q: How can you execute an INSERT SQL query from a Java program using JDBC?
answer: Use Statement or PreparedStatement and executeUpdate() method.
Statement stmt = con.createStatement(); int rows = stmt.executeUpdate("INSERT INTO students(name, age) VALUES('John', 20)");

sq.q: How is executeUpdate() different from executeQuery() in JDBC?
answer: executeUpdate() is used for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE; returns number of affected rows.
executeUpdate() is used for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE; returns number of affected rows.
executeQuery() is used for SELECT; returns a ResultSet .
executeQuery() is used for SELECT; returns a ResultSet .

lq.q: You are building a student management system. Your task is to fetch and display the details (name, department, and marks) of all students who scored above 80 from the students table using JDBC. Use proper SQL execution and result processing techniques. Write a Java program that: Connects to the MySQL database college Connects to the MySQL database college Executes a SELECT query to get students with marks > 80 Executes a SELECT query to get students with marks > 80 Retrieves and displays results using ResultSet Retrieves and displays results using ResultSet Handles exceptions and closes all JDBC resources properly Handles exceptions and closes all JDBC resources properly
answer: public class TopStudents { public static void main(String[] args) { String url = "jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/college"; String user = "root"; String password = "admin";
Connection con = null; Statement stmt = null; ResultSet rs = null;
// Create connection con = DriverManager.getConnection(url, user, password);
// Execute query rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT name, department, marks FROM students WHERE marks > 80");

// Process result while (rs.next()) { String name = rs.getString("name"); String dept = rs.getString("department"); int marks = rs.getInt("marks"); System.out.println(name + " | " + dept + " | " + marks); } } catch (Exception e) { e.printStackTrace(); } finally { try { if (rs != null) rs.close(); } catch (Exception e) {} try { if (stmt != null) stmt.close(); } catch (Exception e) {} try { if (con != null) con.close(); } catch (Exception e) {} } } }
